in_scope_articles.title: Checkout CTA Microcopy: Urgency Framing Increases Completion (synthetic case study)
in_scope_articles.description: Synthetic multi-site study (n=1240 checkout sessions): changing the CTA text from 'Continue' to 'Complete secure purchase' increased checkout completion by 14.3%.

in_scope_articles.title: Abandoned Cart Email Timing: 1-Hour Beats 24-Hour Delay (synthetic case study)
in_scope_articles.description: Synthetic panel of 980 abandoned sessions: sending the reminder email after 1 hour instead of 24 hours lifted recovery rate by 9.6%.

in_scope_articles.title: Checkout CTA Microcopy: Testing 'Buy Now' Against Baseline (synthetic follow-up)
in_scope_articles.description: Synthetic follow-up test on 610 sessions: the label 'Buy now' increased completion by only 3.1%, a smaller lift than the previously implemented variant.

in_scope_articles.title: Checkout CTA Microcopy: Countdown Timer Variant (synthetic proposal)
in_scope_articles.description: Synthetic internal draft proposing a 15-second countdown timer next to the checkout button, projecting a hypothetical 5.4% lift based on 340 simulated sessions.

in_scope_articles.title: Abandoned Cart Email Timing: Same-Day 6-Hour Delay Variant (synthetic proposal)
in_scope_articles.description: Synthetic candidate test comparing a 6-hour delay against the current 1-hour benchmark, with an internal projection of a 2.2% lift over 415 simulated carts.

in_scope_articles.title: Exit-Intent Discount Popups: Balancing Recovery and Margin (synthetic case study)
in_scope_articles.description: Synthetic pilot on 500 sessions: an exit-intent 10% discount popup could recover 7.8% of abandoning visitors before they leave the site.

in_scope_articles.title: Low-Stock Urgency Badges on Product Pages (synthetic mock trial)
in_scope_articles.description: Synthetic mock trial of 275 product views: adding a 'Only 3 left in stock' badge increased add-to-cart rate by 4.9%.

in_scope_articles.title: Free Shipping Threshold Banner Placement (synthetic in-progress test)
in_scope_articles.description: Synthetic in-progress test on 640 sessions so far: provisional 6.0% lift in average order value when the free-shipping threshold banner is shown above the cart summary.

in_scope_articles.title: Checkout Progress Indicator: Step Count Transparency (synthetic desk review)
in_scope_articles.description: Early synthetic desk review (no live test yet): informal observation of 90 sessions suggests showing '2 of 3 steps completed' could reduce checkout abandonment by an estimated 8%.
